candidate_windows.window_text: We use the BART implementation from fairseq as the basis of our corrector. $^3$ The pre-trained BART model is fine-tuned on our training dataset for 10 epochs as described in Section 3.2. The learning rate is set to 3e-5. All our experiments is done on 4 NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPUs. The training process takes about 12 hours.
